title: Etna eruption
description: Fresh lava and ash reshaped Etna's summit during the eruption of 6 to 21 August 2026. NISAR radar images from before and after show where the surface changed, even under the cloud that hid the summit from optical satellites.

title: Ávila wildfire
description: A forest wildfire broke out near Burgohondo in the province of Ávila. Burnt forest reflects radar more weakly, so the burn shows up between two NISAR passes; optical Sentinel-2 imagery is the independent check.

title: Rasuwa glacier-collapse flood
description: A glacier collapse north of Langtang sent water and debris down the Bhote Koshi valley. Two independent radar methods trace the flood path for about 40 km, past Timure and Syabrubesi.

title: Mining subsidence in Poland
description: The ground above active coal mines sinks continuously. Nine consecutive NISAR interferograms from June to October 2026 show 25 sinking bowls, each confirmed by a second satellite track. On 28 October 2026 a sinkhole opened next to a house in Krzyżowice, inside the fastest-sinking area on our map.

title: Flooding along the Limpopo
description: NASA documents NISAR observations before and during flooding. A candidate for comparing open water and inundated vegetation. Our own pixel analysis has not been performed.

title: Ground movement · Venezuela
description: Candidate GUNW study of earthquake-related line-of-sight displacement. Phase corrections, reference selection and quality assessment are required before interpreting movement.

title: Hubbard Glacier · surface deposits
description: Candidate study of avalanche and landslide deposits following the Hubbard Glacier earthquake. Radar roughness, snow and glacier motion need to be distinguished.

title: Forest fire · Canada
description: Demonstration scenario for the wildfire category. No NISAR analysis or burned-area estimate is available.

title: Forest change · Brazil
description: Demonstration catalog entry. This marker illustrates a future workflow, not an observed change or an assessment of forest loss.

title: Volcanic terrain · Iceland
description: Demonstration scenario. A future study could compare radar observations of volcanic terrain with independent references.

title: Ground movement · Japan
description: Demonstration scenario for finding earthquake-related studies. No earthquake occurrence or deformation measurement is asserted.

title: River flooding · Pakistan
description: Demonstration scenario for a flood-mapping workflow. The marker does not represent a validated inundation map.

title: Ice dynamics · Greenland
description: Demonstration scenario for ice observations. Radar surface change does not directly measure lost ice volume.

title: Volcanic terrain · Indonesia
description: Demonstration scenario illustrating the volcano category and regional navigation.

title: Forest fire · Australia
description: Demonstration scenario. No burned area or radar classification has been computed.
